source_ref: Dong J, Chen X, Chen C, Chen C (2025) PLOS ONE 20(9):e0331560, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0331560 (CC BY 4.0); S1 Data (.s001, XLSX) Sheet1 column headers 11-26 = the 16 item stems, and its stored label strings = the response options; article section 3.2 for the label->integer coding; data/dong_2025_teacher_leadership.py
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: S1 Data's Sheet1 column headers ARE the full item wording, each prefixed with its own item number ('1. I have a clear plan...' ... '16. There are teacher leadership behaviors present in your school.'), and data/dong_2025_teacher_leadership.py renames the columns matching ^\d+\. to item_{i+1} in file order, so item_N is the header numbered N -- the positional step is checkable from the header text itself and no inference remains. Deviation: the leading 'N. ' numbering was stripped from each header; nothing else was altered. Option text is the verbatim label strings stored in S1 Data ('complete non-compliance' ... 'complete compliance', lowercase as in the file); the label->integer direction is stated outright in the paper's section 3.2 ('5 representing complete compliance, 4 representing relatively compliance, 3 representing basic compliance, 2 representing basic non-compliance, and 1 representing complete non-compliance') and is independently corroborated quota-free against server-side aggregates: in S1 Data exactly six of the sixteen items (4,5,6,8,10,11) have no 'complete non-compliance' response and four distinct labels, and irw_table_sets() reports resp_min=2 with n_resp_levels=4 for exactly those same six item codes (all other ten have resp_min=1, 5 levels) -- a 6-of-16 signature (1 in 8008 by chance) that would break under any permutation of the item codes and under a flipped label->integer direction. Per-item n is 400 for all 16 items in both the file and the live table. LANGUAGE FALLBACK: administration was in Chinese (inferred -- the paper does not say so, but the sample is Xinjiang primary/secondary teachers and the questionnaire's own title is Chinese); zero CJK characters appear in S1 Data, S2 Data or the article, so English base fields with language=Chinese and the _translated columns omitted, per the scoped-recoverability rule. instructions and section_prompt blank -- none published; the paper states the four dimensions were deliberately NOT disclosed to respondents, so a single trivial section_id is correct. correct_response blank: a self-assessment scale has no key. RIGHTS: PLOS ONE CC BY 4.0, instrument developed by the study's own authors; no non-commercial, redistribution or fee clause found anywhere in the article or supplements, so no wording_rights column. RETRY TEST: NO -- determinate, the extraction completed and passed the gate.
public_note: The 16 items are shipped in the authors' English wording from the S1 Data column headers; the questionnaire was administered to teachers in Xinjiang, China and no Chinese wording appears in the article or either supplementary workbook, so this is an English substitute for what respondents read. The paper's own prose quotes some of the same items in a slightly different English rendering.
